sentences.text: Pythagoras of Samos -LRB- -LSB- pɪˈθægərəs -RSB- -LSB- paɪˈθægərəs -RSB- -LSB- Πυθαγόρας ὁ Σάμιος , Pythagóras ho Sámios , Pythagoras the Samos , Samian -RSB- , or simply Πυθαγόρας Πυθαγόρης in Ionian Greek ; -RRB- was an Ionian Greek philosopher , mathematician , and putative founder of the Pythagoreanism movement .	Samos	Samos	Pythagoreanism	Pythagoreanism	Ionian Greek	Ionian Greek	Ionian	Ionians	Greek	Ancient Greeks	philosopher	Greek philosophy	mathematician	mathematician

He is often revered as a great mathematician and scientist and is best known for the Pythagorean theorem which bears his name .	Pythagorean theorem	Pythagorean theorem	mathematician	mathematician	scientist	scientist
Legend and obfuscation cloud his work , so it is uncertain whether he truly contributed much to mathematics or natural philosophy .	mathematics	mathematics	natural philosophy	natural philosophy
Many of the accomplishments credited to Pythagoras may actually have been accomplishments of his colleagues or successors .
Some accounts mention that the philosophy associated with Pythagoras was related to mathematics and that numbers were important .	mathematics	mathematics

It was said that he was the first man to call himself a philosopher , or lover of wisdom , and Pythagorean ideas exercised a marked influence on Plato , and through him , all of Western philosophy .	Western philosophy	Western philosophy	Plato	Plato	philosopher	Greek philosophy
